Trigger invariants: a pointer-like value reaches dereference, field access, or indirect call, the active path does not prove the value is non-null, Patch-backed trigger clue: added guard: if (lcd->im_pins) {

Silence invariants: a dominating non-null check or successful initializer proves the value is safe, patch-added early return or validation guard blocks the null path, length/capacity guard present: if (lcd->im_pins) {

Transfer axes: equivalent nullability guards before sibling dereference sites, equivalent initialization or validation patterns for the same pointer role, equivalent guard or barrier predicates on sibling paths

validation_expectations: Vulnerable version should trigger a null_dereference finding.
Patched version should stay silent for the same mechanism.
Semantic validation that executes but returns zero hits is not acceptable; recover coverage with evidence-backed semantics.
Repair phase may fix syntax/interfaces only; it must not simplify away the core detection logic.
Generalization must stay inside the mechanism contract transfer axes instead of widening to adjacent bug families.
